name: Contact-sales enterprise tier
definition: Self-serve plan cards followed by a visually distinct enterprise tier that replaces a price with a contact-sales call to action.
bestUse: Products sold both self-serve and through a sales team.

demo.how: Self-serve plans show a price and a sign-up button; the enterprise tier is styled differently and lists what only a contract brings, such as security review and an account manager, with Talk to sales instead of a price. Play shows the self-serve cards, then the enterprise card, then its call to action.
